text:
maria: Heads-up — we've been seeing intermittent missing routing metadata for requests originating from the Python client when a local request-mutation shim is used during app startup. Console shows `route=null` spikes for a subset of tenants.

shiv: Can you paste a minimal repro?

maria: Simple: import sdk, set client.route = 'billing.v2' in a startup hook, then immediately spawn background workers that call client.generate(). On ~2-3% of runs the `x-rd-route` header doesn't reach the internal proxy.

tom: sounds like a request cloning/copy timing issue — some frameworks deep-clone the Request object after SDK mutates it. If the SDK adds headers early, they can be dropped during that clone.

maria: Exactly. I instrumented the SDK and noticed we currently attach route metadata in `Client.build_request()`; if anything else later rewrites the headers object the metadata vanishes.

carmen: What are the options? Move injection later in the stack?

shiv: Two approaches: (A) keep current and add defensive copying so headers survive clones, (B) move route injection to the transport layer (right before the actual HTTP send). Option B guarantees wire-level presence but changes when the header appears relative to hooks/shims.

maria: Option B is attractive because it aligns with the signal we actually need for console attribution. But it could break internal shims that read `Request.headers` earlier in the lifecycle.

ops-bot: Suggested mitigation: implement a phased rollout flag + telemetry to detect regressions automatically.

tom: Proposal: introduce ENV `RD_SDK_ROUTE_INJECT=transport` to enable transport-level injection. Default remains `build` for this minor release. When enabled, the SDK will also emit an internal event `route_injected_at=transport` to telemetry so ingestion can reconcile timing.

carmen: Console changes: we'll need to consume the `route_injected_at` marker and prefer the on-wire header if present. Also add a temporary ingestion column `sdk_route_phase` to the request table.

shiv: Tests: unit tests for shim-copy patterns + an integration test that runs the internal proxy container locally and validates `x-rd-route` on incoming TCP connections. Add a fuzzing case that simulates fast startup and concurrent requests.

maria: I'll open the Python PR and draft the changelog. Can we also prepare corresponding design notes for Go/TS SDKs so all three clients can adopt the same toggle?

tom: Go has different header immutability semantics; we'll likely implement a transport hook there too. TS might already be doing transport-level mutation in `fetch` wrapper — need to confirm. I'll sync with Go/TS leads and produce a short alignment doc.

carmen: Rollout plan: opt-in for 7 days across internal teams -> monitor console metric `pct_requests_missing_route` and an alert if it increases >0.1% for any large tenant -> enable for select beta customers for 2 weeks -> flip default + announce deprecation of old behavior with 30-day grace.

shiv: Add a console tile: time-series of `missing_route_rate` + `sdk_route_phase` breakdown and a heatmap of affected tenant IDs. QA should create a smoke alert that fires on any tenant with >0.5% missing during canary.

maria: I've created a draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/python-sdk/pull/9482 (WIP). It includes: code to support `RD_SDK_ROUTE_INJECT`, unit/integration tests, a `migration.md` note, and telemetry event `route_inject_phase`.

tom: Nice. Devex: please add a short snippet to `quickstart.md` showing how to toggle the env var and a tiny local script to run the proxy and assert the header (we can include `docker-compose` snippet).

carmen: Console work items: schema migration PR (backfill to set `sdk_route_phase` for historical rows if we can infer it), dashboard tile, and the canary alert. I'll target a review by EOD.

shiv: One more thought — if some customers rely on reading the header in middleware that runs before transport, we should document that change and provide a compatibility shim: a helper `sdk.set_route_early(req)` that injects into the Request object for those users.

maria: Good call. I'll include that helper in the PR and mark it as deprecated in the changelog.

tom: Alright. Action items recap: (1) Python PR with flag/tests/migration doc (maria) (2) Console schema + dashboard + alert (carmen) (3) Go/TS alignment doc and leads sync (tom) (4) Quickstart snippet and local proxy script (devex) (shiv to coordinate).

maria: I'll ping everyone on the PR and schedule a 15m sync tomorrow to confirm integration tests. Thanks all. :rocket:
